16e4ba81-b782-4a97-9b4d-6de2390f0f72.text: La Silla Vacía's poll aggregator includes data from 11 pollsters—ranked based on methodology and accuracy—and weighted accordingly.

3c91e83d-4549-491b-8945-2e78f97b83b0.text: Regions are as follows: Antioquia and Eje Cafetero (Antioquia, Caldas, Quindío, and Risaralda), Bogotá, Caribbean (Atlántico, Bolívar, Cesar, Córdoba, La Guajira, Magdalena, San Andrés y Providencia, and Sucre), Center-East (Arauca, Boyacá, Casanare, Cundimarca, North Santander, and Santander), Center-South (Caquetá, Guainía, Guaviare, Huila, Meta, Putumayo, Tolima, Vaupés, and Vichada), and Pacific (Cauca, Chocó, Nariño, and Valle del Cauca)

data: Of Colombians definitely plan to vote. Another 13.5% say they probably will vote. Voting is not mandatory in Colombia.
